title: How well does a simple decline curve forecast Canadian wells?
summary: A backtest of a bounded Arps decline curve on about 1,900 Alberta, Saskatchewan and BC wells: how accurate a 12-month forecast is, how much history you need, and why the curve runs low.

title: Why the decline curve runs low: wells that bounce back
summary: About 35 to 50% of wells recover after the training window. A low month just before the forecast multiplies the typical miss by two to five, but does not explain all of it.

title: Gas has a season. Oil mostly doesn't.
summary: Alberta and BC gas run 6 to 10% above trend in winter and below it through summer and early autumn. Oil barely moves with the calendar.
